kurals.tr: Pazhaimai Enappatuvadhu Yaadhenin Yaadhum / Kizhamaiyaik Keezhndhitaa Natpu
kurals.m: Imtimate friendship is that which cannot in the least be injured by (things done through the) right (of longstanding intimacy)

kurals.tr: Natpir Kuruppuk Kezhudhakaimai Matradharku / Uppaadhal Saandror Katan
kurals.m: The constituents of friendship are (things done through) the right of intimacy; to be pleased with such a right is the duty of the wise

kurals.tr: Pazhakiya Natpevan Seyyung Kezhudhakaimai / Seydhaangu Amaiyaak Katai
kurals.m: Of what avail is long-standing friendship, if friends do not admit as their own actions done through the right of intimacy ?

kurals.tr: Vizhaidhakaiyaan Venti Iruppar Kezhudhakaiyaar / Kelaadhu Nattaar Seyin
kurals.m: If friends, through the right of friendship, do (anything) without being asked, the wise will be pleased with them on account of its desirability

kurals.tr: Pedhaimai Ondro Perungizhamai Endrunarka / Nodhakka Nattaar Seyin
kurals.m: If friends should perform what is painful, understand that it is owing not only to ignorance, but also to the strong claims of intimacy

kurals.tr: Ellaikkan Nindraar Thuravaar Tholaivitaththum / Thollaikkan Nindraar Thotarpu
kurals.m: Those who stand within the limits (of true friendship) will not even in adversity give up the intimacy of long-standing friends

kurals.tr: Azhivandha Seyyinum Anparaar Anpin / Vazhivandha Kenmai Yavar
kurals.m: Those who have (long) stood in the path of affection will not give it up even if their friends cause (them) their ruin

kurals.tr: Kelizhukkam Kelaak Kezhudhakaimai Vallaarkku / Naalizhukkam Nattaar Seyin
kurals.m: To those who understand that by which they should not listen to (tales about) the faults of their friends, that is a (profitable) day on which the latter may commit a fault

kurals.tr: Ketaaa Vazhivandha Kenmaiyaar Kenmai / Vitaaar Vizhaiyum Ulaku
kurals.m: They will be loved by the world, who have not forsaken the friendship of those with whom they have kept up an unbroken long-standing intimacy

kurals.tr: Vizhaiyaar Vizhaiyap Patupa Pazhaiyaarkan / Panpin Thalaippiriyaa Thaar
kurals.m: Even enemies will love those who have never changed in their affection to their long-standingfriends
